Integrate Google Play Billing in Android Capacitor App
Posted 3 days ago

Worldwide

Send a proposal for: 10 Connects
Available Connects: 114
Summary

I have a live Android app on Google Play (package com.nuomyko.twa). It's a Capacitor app with server.url pointing to my live web app (app.nuomyko.com), so the web app is loaded live, not bundled. The web app is React, TypeScript, and Supabase, built with Lovable, with code on GitHub. The website takes payments with Razorpay.

I need Google Play Billing inside the Android app only:

Two subscriptions (monthly and yearly) and several one-time products (question packs and reports), using a Capacitor billing plugin
Purchase buttons open Google Play checkout when running inside the Android app; the website keeps Razorpay exactly as it is
Server-side purchase verification with the Google Play Developer API, plus real-time developer notifications for renewals, cancellations, and refunds, updating the same Supabase entitlements the website uses
Enable R8 code shrinking and optimization in the release build (Play Console has flagged low DEX optimization)
Build and upload the new version to Google Play

The Play merchant account is set up and enrolled in the 15% service fee. Please include proof that website payments still work after your changes, and that the in-app purchase works for both new and existing users. Milestone-based payment preferred.

$1,000.00

Fixed-price
Expert
Experience Level
Project Type:Ongoing project

You will be asked to answer the following questions when submitting a proposal:

Have you implemented Google Play Billing in a Capacitor app before? Which plugin did you use? Please share an example.
How will you verify purchases on the server and handle renewals and cancellations?
How will you make sure the website's Razorpay checkout keeps working after your changes?
What is your fixed price and timeline for this scope, split into milestones?
Include a link to your GitHub profile and/or website
